be opening land for millions to inhabit. Not in total security, of course, but safe enough, a life of free activity. I see endless fields, vast and fruitful, where man and beast alike will flock to live, contented and at peace on the new-made land, protected by the massive sheltering barrier raised by the labor of a bold and fearless people. Life in this interior will be a paradise, while outside the sea may rage to the crest of the mighty dam. And when the waters gnaw and threaten to rush in through the masons’ work, the people as one will rise to close the breach. Yes! To this philosophy I am wholly given, wisdom can reach no further: He alone is worthy of life and freedom who has to win them by conquest every day. And so, ringed round with danger, young and old will live a life dedicated to vigorous activity. Such a lusty throng I long to see, and stand on free ground with a people free! If this were so, I might say to the passing moment: “Linger awhile, you are so fair!” The traces of my days on earth can never— no, not in eons—pass away. In expectation of that highest bliss, I now enjoy my greatest moment—this! (浮士德 sinks back, the LEMURS seize him and lay him on the ground.)

@@U04606@@
Pleasure never satisfied this man, no bliss contented him, and so he went on whoring after shifting forms.
translation:
@@U04604@@
开放土地供数百万人居住。当然，不是完全安全，但足够安全，自由活动的生活。我看到一望无际的田野，广阔而富饶，人类和野兽都将涌向这里，在新开垦的土地上安居乐业地生活，受到勇敢无畏的人民的劳动所建立的巨大庇护屏障的保护。内陆地区的生活将是天堂，而外面的大海可能会汹涌到大坝的顶峰。当洪水侵蚀并威胁要冲进泥瓦匠的工作时，人民就会团结起来堵住缺口。是的！我完全相信这一哲学，智慧无法再进一步：只有每天通过征服来赢得生命和自由的人才配得上生命和自由。因此，在危险的包围下，年轻人和老年人都将过着充满活力的生活。我渴望看到如此精力充沛的人群，并与自由的人民一起站在自由的土地上！如果是这样，我可能会对那一瞬间说：“再呆一会儿，你真公平！”我在地球上的日子的痕迹永远不会——不，不会在亿万年里——消失。怀着对最高幸福的期盼，我现在享受着我最伟大的时刻——这一刻！ （浮士德向后退去，狐猴抓住他并把他放在地上。）

@@U04606@@
快乐永远不能满足这个人，幸福也不能满足他，所以他不断变换形态继续嫖娼。
